title: Painting & Paddling with the Pup
content: I deploy the gouache easel beside Rondout Creek and open to a page primed with blue acryla-gouache.Most of the afternoon colors are warm gray over that. Inevitably the blue pops through here and there, activating the warm colors.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)Here's the video, which includes Smooth digging in the soft bank and a little kayak excursion.
